"""Bounded native -> publication -> JSON timings; setup and checks unmeasured."""
import argparse
from dataclasses import replace
import json
import random
from time import perf_counter

from dnd.actions import Move
from dnd.content.items.ground_hardware_builders import materialize_ground_hardware
from dnd.content.items.environment_item_builders import build_authored_door
from dnd.content_system.bootstrap import bootstrap_content_system
from dnd.content_system.runtime import SERVER_CONTENT_SYSTEM_RUNTIME
from dnd.core.dice import fixed_dice_faces
from dnd.core.events import EventPhase, EventQueue, MechanismInstallEvent
from dnd.core.gridmap import get_map
from dnd.core.modifiers import NumericalModifier
from dnd.core.values import Channel, Kind, add_modifier
from dnd.player.application import capture_application_operation, initialize_audiences
from dnd.player.audience import PlayerAudience
from dnd.player.content_composition import ui_content_manifest
from dnd.player.session import close_session, create_session, publish_sheets
from dnd.spatial.environmental_conditions import SpikeTrap
from dnd.spatial.gas_traps import GasVent
from dnd.spatial.jaws import JawTrap
from dnd.spatial.triggers import PressurePlate, Tripwire
from dnd.spells.abjuration import GlyphOfWarding, GlyphOfWardingZone
from dnd.types.character_progression import CharacterClass
from dnd.types.controls import ActivationLink
from dnd.types.world import CardinalDirection
from tests.manual.spell_regression_support import force_save_result
from tests.player.test_emitted_update_replica import operation_since
from tests.progression.prepared_class_support import prepared_build


def measure(case, sample, session, audiences, catalog, action):
    cursor = EventQueue.event_cursor()
    start = perf_counter()
    result = action()
    native_end = perf_counter()
    updates = capture_application_operation(audiences, operation_since(session, cursor), catalog)
    published = perf_counter()
    packets = [update.model_dump_json().encode() for update in updates.values()]
    end = perf_counter()
    print(json.dumps(dict(case=case, sample=sample, warmup=sample == 0,
        native_ms=(native_end-start)*1000, publication_ms=(published-native_end)*1000,
        encoding_ms=(end-published)*1000, total_ms=(end-start)*1000,
        max_packet_bytes=max(map(len, packets)), total_packet_bytes=sum(map(len, packets)),
        event_versions=EventQueue.event_cursor()-cursor)), flush=True)
    return result


def install(mechanism, item_id):
    cause = EventQueue.publish_declaration(MechanismInstallEvent(name='Install measured trap',
        source_entity_uuid=mechanism.source_entity_uuid, use_register=False))
    cause = cause.phase_to(EventPhase.EXECUTION).phase_to(EventPhase.EFFECT)
    body = materialize_ground_hardware(mechanism, item_id=item_id, parent_event=cause)
    cause.phase_to(EventPhase.COMPLETION)
    return body


parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--case', choices=('glyph', 'traps', 'doors'), required=True)
parser.add_argument('--samples', type=int, default=6)
args = parser.parse_args()
SERVER_CONTENT_SYSTEM_RUNTIME.install(bootstrap_content_system())
catalog = ui_content_manifest()
for sample in range(args.samples):
    random.seed(6)
    session = create_session(player_builds=(prepared_build(CharacterClass.WIZARD, 7),),
        enemy_positions=((14, 12), (14, 14)))
    try:
        caster = session.game.entities[session.player_uuids[0]]
        enemy = next(actor for actor in session.game.entities.values() if actor.position == (14, 12))
        add_modifier(enemy.health.max_hit_points_bonus, Channel.SELF_STATIC, Kind.VALUE,
            NumericalModifier(name='Survive measured Glyph contact', value=100, source_entity_uuid=enemy.uuid))
        session = replace(session, player_uuids=(*session.player_uuids, enemy.uuid))
        session.seats['recipient'] = PlayerAudience((enemy.uuid,), (enemy.uuid,))
        publish_sheets(session)
        force_save_result(enemy, 'dexterity', succeeds=False)
        if args.case == 'doors':
            doors = {}
            for direction in CardinalDirection:
                door = build_authored_door('environment.door.fantasy_a1')
                door.place_on_grid((13, 11), boundary_direction=direction)
                doors[direction] = door
            spikes = SpikeTrap(source_entity_uuid=caster.uuid, position=(13, 11),
                affected_positions={(13, 11), (11, 11)})
            body = install(spikes, 'environment.trap.spikes')
        audiences, _ = initialize_audiences(session, catalog)
        if args.case == 'glyph':
            cursor = EventQueue.event_cursor()
            result = GlyphOfWarding(source_entity_uuid=caster.uuid, end_position=(11, 10), payload='fire').apply()
            assert result is not None and not result.canceled
            capture_application_operation(audiences, operation_since(session, cursor), catalog)
            zone, = (z for z in get_map().get_spatial_conditions() if isinstance(z, GlyphOfWardingZone))
            assert all(zone.uuid in runtime.projection.audience_composition.view.spatial_effects
                for runtime in audiences.values())
            hp = enemy.get_normal_hp()
            with fixed_dice_faces(*([3] * 200)):
                result = measure('glyph_held_entry', sample, session, audiences, catalog,
                    lambda: Move(source_entity_uuid=enemy.uuid, end_position=(12, 11)).apply())
            assert result is not None and not result.canceled
            assert not zone.applied and enemy.get_normal_hp() == hp - 15
        elif args.case == 'traps':
            gas = GasVent(source_entity_uuid=caster.uuid, position=(9, 11), affected_positions={(9, 11)})
            link = ActivationLink(target_condition_uuid=gas.uuid)
            rows = (
                (gas, 'environment.trap.gas_vent'),
                (JawTrap(source_entity_uuid=caster.uuid, position=(10, 12), affected_positions={(10, 12)}), 'environment.trap.jaw'),
                (PressurePlate(source_entity_uuid=caster.uuid, position=(10, 11), affected_positions={(10, 11)}, link=link), 'environment.trap.pressure_plate'),
                (Tripwire(source_entity_uuid=caster.uuid, position=(11, 12), across=(12, 12),
                    affected_positions={(11, 12), (12, 12)}, link=link), 'environment.trap.tripwire'),
                (SpikeTrap(source_entity_uuid=caster.uuid, position=(9, 12), affected_positions={(9, 12)}), 'environment.trap.spikes'),
            )
            items = measure('five_trap_installations', sample, session, audiences, catalog,
                lambda: [install(mechanism, item_id) for mechanism, item_id in rows])
            assert len(items) == 5 and all(mechanism.applied for mechanism, _ in rows)
            assert all(mechanism.uuid in audiences['party'].projection.audience_composition.view.spatial_effects
                for mechanism, _ in rows)
        else:
            view = audiences['party'].projection.audience_composition.view
            assert body.uuid not in view.objects and spikes.uuid in view.spatial_effects
            measure('anchor_housing_door_open', sample, session, audiences, catalog,
                doors[CardinalDirection.WEST].open)
            assert body.uuid in audiences['party'].projection.audience_composition.view.objects
            measure('anchor_housing_door_close', sample, session, audiences, catalog,
                doors[CardinalDirection.WEST].close)
            view = audiences['party'].projection.audience_composition.view
            assert body.uuid not in view.objects and spikes.uuid in view.spatial_effects
    finally:
        close_session(session)

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

python = '/home/tommaso/.cache/dnd-engine/venv/bin/python'

for case in ('glyph', 'traps', 'doors'):

        root = Path('/tmp/rules-checking-trap-glyph-' + side)
        env = {**os.environ, 'PYTHONPATH': str(root), 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE': '1', 'PYTHONHASHSEED': '71'}
